# Brightside

> > Brightside provides online mental health treatment combining psychiatry, therapy, and cognitive behavioral therapy for anxiety, depression, and other mental health conditions.

Brightside is a telehealth platform offering personalized psychiatric care and therapy services with AI-assisted medication management (PrecisionRx) and evidence-based treatment for various mental health conditions. The platform accepts insurance including Medicare and Medicaid, and features hand-selected providers including psychiatrists like Mimi Winsberg, MD.

## Key Topics

- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Online Psychiatry
- Mental Health Treatment
- Depression Treatment
- Anxiety Disorders
- Telehealth Services
- Medication Management
- Therapy Services
- Major Depressive Disorder (MDD)
- Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD)
- Insurance Coverage
- Psychiatric Care
- PrecisionRx
- Mental Health Conditions
- Suicide Prevention

## Core Services

- [Anxiety & Depression Treatment Online | Medication & Therapy](https://www.brightside.com): Brightside homepage: online mental health treatment with psychiatry, therapy, and suicide prevention services.
- [Online Psychiatry & Prescriptions | Appointments in 48 hours - Brightside](https://www.brightside.com/psychiatry): Brightside's online psychiatry service with PrecisionRx AI-personalized prescriptions.
- [Our Providers - Brightside](https://www.brightside.com/our-providers): Directory of hand-selected psychiatric providers and therapists including Mimi Winsberg, MD.

## Mental Health Conditions & Treatment

- [Treating Major Depressive Disorder: Clinically Proven Methods - Brightside](https://www.brightside.com/conditions/major-depressive-disorder): Evidence-based guide to MDD treatment with therapy and personalized medication options.
- [Understanding Generalized Anxiety Disorder and How to Treat It](https://www.brightside.com/conditions/generalized-anxiety-disorder): Treatment guide for GAD combining therapy, medication, and cognitive behavioral therapy.
- [Understanding Panic Disorder: Symptoms and Treatment Options - Brightside](https://www.brightside.com/conditions/panic-disorder): Educational guide on panic disorder symptoms and personalized treatment options.
- [Understanding Social Anxiety Disorder: Symptoms and Treatment - Brightside](https://www.brightside.com/conditions/social-anxiety-disorder): Guide to social anxiety disorder treatment with cognitive behavioral therapy options.
- [Managing Bipolar Disorder: Effective Online Care - Brightside](https://www.brightside.com/conditions/bipolar): Treatment guide for bipolar I and II disorder with personalized psychiatric care.
- [Online Insomnia Treatment: Get Life-Changing Care from Home - Brightside](https://www.brightside.com/conditions/insomnia): Guide to insomnia treatment using cognitive behavioral therapy and psychiatric medication.
- [Understanding & Treating Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)](https://www.brightside.com/conditions/ptsd): Educational resource on PTSD symptoms and cognitive behavioral therapy treatment.
- [Online Postpartum Depression (PPD) Treatment & Counseling - Brightside](https://www.brightside.com/conditions/postpartum-depression): Guide to postpartum depression treatment and expert counseling for maternal mental health.
- [Effective OCD Treatment: Personalized Care for Lasting Results](https://www.brightside.com/conditions/ocd): Treatment guide for obsessive-compulsive disorder using cognitive behavioral therapy.
- [Effective Online Phobia Treatment: Personalized Care - Brightside](https://www.brightside.com/conditions/phobia): Guide to phobia treatment using cognitive behavioral therapy and personalized care.
